name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - FEBRUARY 11, 2008 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
Invocation
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
Public Comments
4.
Items for Discussion and/or Consideration
4A.
Consideration, including possible interviews, and determination regarding applications for appointment to fill a City Council vacancy
4B.
If the City Council makes a determination to make an appointment to fill a City Council vacancy: Consideration of adoption of a resolution of appointment; and Consideration of adoption of a resolution canceling the June 3, 2008 Special Election; and Consideration of adoption of a resolution withdrawing a request to consolidate with the County of Los Angeles primary election to be held on June 3, 2008.
5.
Adjournment
Recess
Reconvene
